item.title: 23 Best Christmas Movies to Watch With Your Teens
item.description: The winter holidays are all about family time. Whether playing games, enjoying sports (both the doing and the watching), sharing great meals, or settling down to watch a movie, this is our favorite time of year. With the dark coming early, nothing is better than gathering to watch a Christmas movie together.
